item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: LanFi 5.5.2
item.description:
macOS Open Source WiFi Analysis Tool

LanFi is a native macOS Wi-Fi analysis tool that scans nearby wireless networks based on the Apple CoreWLAN framework, transforming signal strength, signal-to-noise ratio, channel overlap, utilization, and security configurations into interpretable quality scores to help users determine connection status and troubleshoot wireless network issues. The software supports Wi-Fi 4 to Wi-Fi 7 recognition, providing 2. 4, 5, and 6 GHz frequency band charts and sorted channel suggestions can detect risks related to open network, WEP, legacy WPA, WPS, and management frame protection, and give severity and repair tips. The built-in diagnostic engine covers wireless links, IPv4 and IPv6, gateways, DNS, portal authentication, HTTPS, and latency checking in conjunction with signal history and continuous monitoring for location failures. Users can also view underlying protocol fields, analyze offline packet capture files, collect data through SSH remote sensors, import floorplans to generate signal heatmaps, and manage survey results using groupings, tags, notes, and saved sessions.

item.title: Osaurus 1.0.9
item.description:
Unified Management Tool for Multi-Model AI

Osaurus is a native AI bridging and management tool built for macOS. It is implemented entirely in Swift and deeply optimized for Apple Silicon. It supports fully offline local model execution and can also connect to cloud inference services as needed. It is centered around "Agents," each of which has its own independent prompts, memory, topics, and executable tools, and is capable of step-by-step automated task execution, parallel processing, and file operations. With a built-in four-layer memory system, encrypted identity management, and secure WebSocket relay, combined with an isolated Linux sandbox based on Apple containerization, it can execute real code and development toolchains in a secure environment. At the same time, it offers a rich plugin and tool registration mechanism, MCP-compatible interfaces, speech transcription, and developer debugging tools, ensuring that personal data and workflows remain entirely on the local device while providing high scalability. Osaurus is a native AI management platform for macOS that integrates agents, memory, sandboxed execution, plugins, and multi-model support to deliver scalable, privacy-first intelligent workflows.

item.title: Bounce 41.1
item.description:
Wireless Connection Between Mac and Android

Bounce Connect is a local wireless collaboration tool designed specifically for Mac and Android connectivity. It enables features such as sending and receiving text messages, syncing notifications, managing calls, clipboard sharing, and file transfers within the same local area network, allowing mobile content to appear on macOS as if it were a native feature. It supports two-way connections and does not rely on cloud servers. All messages, notifications, contacts, and files are transmitted within the local network and protected by AES-256-GCM encryption to ensure data security. The software also offers practical features such as an iMessage-like messaging interface, dual SIM dialing and messaging, WhatsApp call handling, replyable desktop notifications, remote file browsing, Safari and Chrome link continuity, and image and text clipboard synchronization, making it suitable for users who frequently switch between their computers and Android phones. Bounce Connect is a local wireless connection tool for Mac and Android that integrates text messages, notifications, calls, files, contacts, and clipboards into a single cross-device workflow, allowing you to handle mobile content directly on your Mac and experience near-native system integration.

item.title: RsyncUI 3.5.0
item.description:
Rsync Graphical Interface Program

RsyncUI is a macOS application developed using SwiftUI, designed to provide a graphical user interface for the command-line tool rsync. This software is designed for macOS Sonoma and later versions, making it easier for users to organize synchronization tasks and configure rsync parameters, thereby simplifying the use of rsync. RsyncUI can be installed via Homebrew or downloaded directly, and both options are signed and certified by Apple. The user documentation is based on the Hugo theme and is designed to provide a good user experience. If users find RsyncUI useful, they can encourage developers to continue improving the software by starring the project. RsyncUI provides a convenient solution for macOS users who need to use data synchronization. RsyncUI is a SwiftUI-based macOS application designed to simplify the use of the rsync command-line tool. The app supports macOS Sonoma and later versions, offering a user-friendly graphical interface that helps users more easily organize tasks and set synchronization parameters.

item.title: Raspberry 0.0.18
item.description:
Tahoe's Launchpad Alternative Tool

Raspberry is a Launchpad alternative for macOS Tahoe designed to help users organize their applications more efficiently. In macOS 26, the original Launchpad will be replaced by the new "Apps" application, which lacks the custom grouping and categorization features. This is undoubtedly bad news for users who prefer the original Launchpad interface. Raspberry offers a more flexible way to group applications through its right-click feature, helping users efficiently manage and access applications while enhancing the desktop management experience. Raspberry has the ability to automatically save grouping and sorting settings, and supports importing existing Launchpad groups, simplifying the migration process. Users can automatically index all applications at first launch, ensuring that the index is stored locally even if the Spotlight index is deleted. The app allows users to launch applications and manage groups with simple left- and right-click functions, and supports eight hotkeys to improve operational efficiency. Raspberry features a simple and elegant interface design that clearly displays groups and app icons, and supports quick search and switching.

item.title: Warp 0.2026.11.18.08.17.stable_04
item.description:
Powerful Modern Smart Ai Terminal Tools

Warp is a modern terminal and intelligent coding environment for macOS developers that combines traditional command lines, AI coding agents, multi-model scheduling, and team-level governance capabilities in one workflow. Starting from the terminal experience, it supports developers to directly call Claude Code, Codex, Warp Agent and other agents locally. It can also extend the task to run in the cloud through the Oz Agent Platform, which is suitable for complex software engineering scenarios such as code generation, problem troubleshooting, refactoring migration, PR preliminary examination and incident response. Warp Terminal is open source, emphasizing an open agent ecosystem, connectivity to any tool, choice of inference providers and models, and providing codebase indexing, fine-grained permission control, usage visibility, and enterprise compliance capabilities to enable individual developers and teams to organize automated development tasks more efficiently in a familiar command-line interface.

item.title: Smolpad 1.4.3
item.description:
Menu Bar Markdown Editor

Smolpad is a lightweight Markdown note-taking app for macOS, iPhone, and iPad that saves each note as a plain .md file that can be opened directly by other editors, without relying on a dedicated database or locking content in a closed format. The app can sync profiles through the user's own iCloud Drive and supports Dropbox, the same batch of text can be continuously edited between multiple devices; The Notes Directory can also be opened at any time from the Finder or the Files app. The editor provides checkboxes for titles, bold, italics, quotes, codes, separators, and interactive tasks to weaken or completely hide the Markdown markup as needed, with a formatting toolbar and full keyboard shortcuts. Users can drag or paste images, resize displays, and allow images to be saved and synced with their notes as separate files. Folders, stickies, custom sorting, tag filtering, instant search, and header outlines are great for managing your growing data. Mac version of the permanent menu bar, you can use the shortcut keys to quickly call out, but also can split the notes into a separate window;

item.title: MindSpace 1.10.31
item.description:
Lightweight, concise mind mapping tool

MindSpace is an app designed to quickly create concise mind maps that users can edit on their Mac, iPad, and iPhone and export images or PDFs at any time to share while learning and working. The software allows users to quickly adjust the information structure, distinguish ideas by different colors and formats, insert stickers to make the information more vivid, and provide a rich theme style to help users build a fortress of knowledge. MindSpace also enables the quick capture of inspiration, turning instant ideas into a piece of knowledge with a minimalistic look that puts information at the heart and reduces distractions. At the same time, MindSpace ensures data security and full ownership of the user's data. Users can easily share intuitive mind maps to improve team efficiency. The app adopts a subscription model, users can choose monthly or annual subscriptions, and need to cancel the auto-renewal 24 hours before the end of the subscription, the current subscription fee is not refundable, all terms of service and precautions please read carefully.

item.title: Exporter 5.0.1
item.description:
Apple Notes Exporter

Exporter is a tool designed for Mac that helps users export all their notes in one click from Apple Notes.app, allowing them to be exported in Markdown or HTML format while preserving their full creation and modification dates. The Exporter will follow Notes. the name of the notebook in the app is created to store the corresponding folder structure to ensure that the notes are organized in the same way as the original app. For notes with the same name in the same notebook, the Exporter will automatically rename them to avoid overwriting the old notes with the new ones. The software fully supports the export of all attachments, including images, PDF documents, Word documents (docx), MP4 videos, MP3 audio, MOV, GIF, SVG images, ICS calendar events, and call recordings. Non-image attachments are attached as links at the end of the notes for easy access. The Exporter also provides selective export functionality, allowing users to select specific notebooks for export through folder filters, and supports custom Markdown header and file name formats, with date prefixes added to file names for easy management.

item.title: Capture 3.7
item.description:
Note-taking and idea-gathering tool for macOS

Quick Notes – Capture is a quick note-taking and idea-gathering tool for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision, and Apple Watch, with a core experience centered around low-friction input, instant organization, and cross-app flow. It is suitable for first capturing spontaneous ideas, to-do lists, web links, image attachments, voice content, and reminders, and then exporting them as needed to commonly used tools such as Obsidian, Things, Todoist, iA Writer, Craft, OmniFocus, Fantastical, Apple Calendar, Reminders, etc. The software supports iCloud syncing, desktop and lock screen widgets, share extensions, Siri and Shortcuts, automatic recognition of dates and URLs, document scanning, list sorting, merging and splitting of records, and other features. It can serve both as a daily outlet for clearing your mind and as a hub between different productivity systems. Its interface emphasizes simplicity and stability, avoiding distractions caused by complex workflows, allowing users to quickly save ideas when inspiration strikes and then process, archive, or execute them at the appropriate time.

item.title: LitPads SoundBoard 1.9.12
item.description:
Mac Live Audio Routing Tool

LitPads is a custom soundboard app for musicians, DJs, podcasters, live streamers, theater and live event voice controls, and content creators that creates multiple soundboards on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, imports your own audio files, and triggers playback with ultra-low latency. It supports one-time triggering, looping, switching, press-and-hold playback and other modes. Each Pad can independently adjust the volume, audio, fade, EQ, tone change, clip range and reverb, and provide multi-voice playback. It is suitable for live performances, program crossovers, stage prompts, church and theater cue, TikTok/Reels material production, and live workflows such as OBS, Twitch, YouTube Live, Discord, and Zoom. The Mac side can be used with virtual audio drivers for audio routing. Functions such as MIDI control, track serialization, automatic depression, global fade-out, cue list, and iCloud synchronization make complex performance processes easier to manage.

item.title: Screens 5 5.10.5
item.description:
Cross-platform remote desktop control

Screens makes it easy to remotely control your Mac, Windows computer, Linux computer, or Raspberry Pi, whether you're at home, in a coffee shop, or anywhere else in the world. It's a versatile remote desktop solution known for being fast, secure, and reliable, giving you a seamless device control experience. By installing Screens Connect, you can access your computer from anywhere in the world, and Screens also fully integrates with Tailscale, making it easy to connect to a Linux computer or Raspberry Pi remotely. The curtain mode of Screens protects your privacy, the secure connection function ensures a secure connection to the computer, and supports SSH keys to increase security. It also offers features such as accessible Mac login, display selection, clipboard sharing, session selection, and is compatible with the Raspberry Pi 5, supporting file transfers and an easy-to-use interface, while also helping friends and family through the free Screens Assist tool.

item.title: Mouse Jiggler 3.5.4
item.description:
Mac Mouse Movement Simulation Tool

Mouse Jiggler – Mouse Mover is a lightweight utility designed for Mac that meets a variety of interaction needs by generating subtle, natural mouse cursor movements. It places special emphasis on accessibility design, helping users with low vision to use the moving cursor as a visual anchor, easily locate the pointer, and reduce eye strain. Provides automatic movement for users with limited motor control, such as those with hand tremors, to prevent them from having to constantly shake the mouse manually to keep the pointer responsive. At the same time, it continuously provides visual feedback for users requiring cognitive assistance, confirming that the system interface is actively responsive and not frozen. Mouse Jiggler – Mouse Mover supports the simulation of real mouse input and is compatible with various input devices such as mice, trackpads, and trackballs. It keeps your Mac active in remote desktop, long-duration download, monitoring dashboard, or video conferencing scenarios, preventing the screen from going to sleep or changing to an inactive state. It offers flexible movement options, including various movement styles, silent mode, and an optional auto-click feature, allowing users to customize behavior based on their actual needs.

item.title: Sunlitt 4.11.4
item.description:
Sun path and solar irradiance analysis

Sunlitt is a sun path and sunlight analysis tool for photography, architecture, real estate, and outdoor exploration. It can calculate the sun's position, azimuth, altitude, sunrise and sunset times, golden hour, blue hour, and the solstices in real time based on the current location, and visually display the changes in sunlight and shadow on maps and in scenes. It supports offline viewing of basic data. In conjunction with AR mode, it can preview the sun's path and shadow movement in a real environment. It can also observe the impact of hills and buildings on lighting through shadow maps, terrain shadows, and satellite or terrain views. The app is compatible with iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Vision Pro, offering widgets, Live Activities, Shortcuts, and cross-device syncing. This allows users to quickly access reliable information when choosing locations for photography, selecting shaded seats, planning itineraries, and preparing for outdoor activities. Sunlitt is a cross-platform tool focused on solar trajectories, sunlight analysis, and shadow previews, suitable for photography, architecture, real estate, and outdoor activities. It integrates real-time solar data, map browsing, AR visualization, and event timelines into a single interface, helping users quickly assess how sunlight changes at a specific location on different dates and times.

item.title: ElementNote 2.15.0
item.description:
Handwritten Notes and PDF Annotation Tools

Element Note is a handwriting note-taking, PDF annotation, and lightweight drawing app for macOS, iPadOS, and iOS, emphasizing a simple interface, a natural writing feel, and a high-quality rendering experience. It offers a variety of writing tools, including pencils, pens, ballpoint pens, art brushes, and markers. It also supports gradient ink, stroke smoothing, and Apple Pencil Pro's squeeze, haptic feedback, hover, and roll interactions, making classroom notes, study annotations, journal planning, and sketching feel more like using real paper and pen. The app allows you to insert text, shapes, stickers, and images. It supports practical features such as importing annotations from PDFs, batch exporting, lasso selection, moving content across pages, creating notes from photo albums, and more. With native OCR, you can search PDFs and handwritten content. Combined with tags, subfolders, folder colors, multi-select drag-and-drop, and page organization features, it is suitable for long-term management of a large number of notes. iCloud syncing and collaboration allow notes to be quickly updated across multiple devices and support collaborative editing by multiple users. The intelligent dark mode adjusts the reading environment according to the system appearance while maintaining consistency in the colors of the paper and handwriting.

item.title: FletchShot 2.5.0
item.description:
macOS Screenshot Annotation OCR Tool

FletchShot is a screenshot annotation tool designed for macOS, aimed at those who need to quickly take screenshots, draw arrows, and share them instantly every day. As soon as you finish capturing, the annotation window opens immediately, and the arrow tool is selected. After drawing the arrow, grab the bottom edge label of the window and drag it directly into the Slack message Finder or Terminal, and it will be delivered as an image. You can also press Command+C to copy the content with annotations and paste it at any time. The entire process has no save dialog, no mode selection, and no export procedure. Scroll Capture allows you to scroll the target window yourself when long pages extend beyond the screen. The app stitches frames using ScreenCaptureKit, without the need for plugins, extensions, or accessibility permissions. Screen recording supports three modes: full screen, area, or window. Switch to click highlighting with one tap. The footer allows you to switch between MP4 and GIF formats and choose between high, medium, and low video quality. OCR runs on the device side based on Apple's Vision framework. It can extract error message tables, code, and even JSON on the screen as pastable text and automatically indent it. It prioritizes support for English and Japanese.

item.title: FileZilla Pro 3.72.0
item.description:
Professional SFTP File Transfer Tool for Mac

FileZilla Pro is a professional file transfer and cloud storage management client for macOS. It can connect to remote servers via FTP, FTPS, SFTP, and WebDAV, and natively supports services such as Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Google Drive, Google Cloud Storage, Microsoft OneDrive, Microsoft Azure Storage, Dropbox, Box, and OpenStack Swift. The software features a tabbed interface, allowing users to centrally organize servers, cloud sites, and bookmarks using the Site Manager. It also protects login credentials and synchronized data through an encryption mechanism. It offers features such as local and remote directory comparison, directory synchronization, file search, list filtering, remote file editing, and drag-and-drop transfer. It can use transfer queues to uniformly manage progress in tasks involving a large number of files, with no restrictions on individual file sizes.

item.title: Happy Wallpaper 3.3.2
item.description:
Paper Wallpaper Ultra HD 4K Dynamic Wallpaper

Paper – Live Wallpaper is a 4K live wallpaper app designed for Mac that brings stunning photos to your desktop every day and has been hailed as the best live wallpaper app on Mac. The app handpicked more than 4,000 beautifully animated wallpaper elements, including 4K (Ultra HD) and 5K (Full HD) wallpapers, to ensure that every background is beautiful, while also saving system resources and making the Mac desktop more vivid. If you're looking for dynamic wallpapers for your Mac, don't hesitate, Paper is the app you need. Paper features include one-click preview, setting wallpaper, a wide variety of materials, covering dynamic, 4K ultra-definition, cartoon anime, natural humanities, cute pets, game world, creative videos and other categories, there is always a style for you. It supports multiple screen aspect ratios and native resolutions, and supports hidden desktop icons for an immersive experience. The Paper interface is sophisticated, supports dark mode, pursues the best experience, and is easy to operate and learn. The app is dedicated to simplifying operations, delivering superior performance, and saving battery life. Users can set up wallpapers with one click, without having to open the gallery to find images.

item.title: Perch 1.5.4
item.description:
macOS Dynamic Island Tool Panel

Dynamic Notch Island – Perch is a notch area productivity tool designed specifically for macOS. It transforms the previously unused space at the top of the screen into a smart shelf that can be summoned with the mouse. Here, you can quickly view and control music playback, weather, calendar events, countdowns, and stopwatches. You can also easily access clipboard history, recently copied content, and the temporary file tray, concentrating frequently used operations in the most convenient location. The application adopts a minimalist style throughout, with a lightweight interface that doesn't overshadow the main content. It is suitable for MacBooks with notches and also works stably on models without notches. It supports multiple languages, localization, and continuous performance optimization, making the desktop tidier and the workflow more seamless. Dynamic Notch Island – Perch transforms the notch area of your Mac into an interactive efficiency island. When the mouse approaches, a minimalist panel slides out, centrally displaying commonly used tools such as music controls, weather, calendar, countdown, clipboard history, and a temporary file tray. Designed specifically for macOS, it is compatible with both MacBook models with and without notches, making it ideal for users who want to transform the space at the top of their screen into an access point for frequently used functions.

item.title: Via 1.1
item.description:
Travel itinerary comparison software for macOS

Via: Compare Routes is a door-to-door trip planning and route comparison tool for Mac and iPad, ideal for organizing multiple travel options for complex journeys after checking transportation information such as flights, trains, ferries, buses, and taxis. It is not a transportation search engine, but rather it cross-calculates combinations of different transportation segments based on the cost and time manually entered by the user, and includes round-trip tickets and combination tickets in the comparison to help determine the actual cost of the entire route. The software includes the cost and time of getting to the airport or station in the overall journey, and, taking into account public transport travel times and custom transfer buffers, it marks routes that cannot be realistically completed. For the same trip, users can create alternative plans with different departure and arrival cities, airports, and itinerary sequences. After naming each plan, they can view the rankings side by side. When fares change, simply update the relevant data to recalculate and adjust the order of the options without having to plan from scratch. The app does not require an account registration, does not track user activity, and keeps all entered data locally on the device. This data will not leave the device unless it is actively exported. The Mac version requires macOS 14. 0 or later, with the interface language set to English.

item.title: Snap 3.2.1
item.description:
Lightweight screenshot mapping tool

Snapshots + Stickers is a simple and powerful screenshot tool designed to make users more productive. It allows the user to take a quick screenshot and paste the screenshot directly back to the top of the screen. It is simple to use the shortcut key CMD + 1 to take a screenshot, and then press CMD + 2. The screenshot can be displayed on the desktop at the top. Snap also supports converting the contents of the clipboard into a scalable window, whether it's text or pictures. This feature can dramatically change work habits and improve productivity for users who have been working on computers for a long time. Snap is very simple to use and very secure, it does not contain any ads, does not scan the user's hard drive, and does not upload user data, which ensures the privacy of the user. Snap also provides handy tips, such as dynamically scaling the map with a mouse wheel or touchpad, and double-clicking the map to quickly close it. Snap is ideal for productivity. Snap is a simple yet powerful screenshot tool that not only helps you take quick screenshots, but also puts them back on your screen to dramatically improve your productivity.

item.title: IPTV Expert 11.7.0
item.description:
IPTV Network Streaming Player

IPTV Expert is the ultimate IPTV player designed for a seamless streaming experience, freeing users from dissatisfaction. It supports all IPTV service providers and media content and is loved by thousands of users. IPTV Expert ensures a seamless viewing experience on the go with easy playlist importing, great automatic categorization, Chromecast support, Electronic Program Guide (EPG), offline viewing, replay functionality, subtitle support, and multi-account management. Its beautiful user interface, series browsing features, and picture-in-picture support further enhance the ease and fun of use, resulting in a high-quality streaming experience. Upgrade your viewing experience with IPTV Expert! Tired of unsatisfactory IPTV players? Meet IPTV Expert, the ultimate IPTV player designed for exceptional performance. Loved and trusted by thousands of users, IPTV Expert supports all IPTV providers and media content for unparalleled viewing pleasure.

item.title: SenPlayer 6.3.0
item.description:
macOS Cloud Storage Video Player

SenPlayer is a powerful multi-platform video player that supports 8K decoding, Blu-ray ISO disc images, and a wide range of audio and video formats, offering exceptional decoding capabilities. It not only supports Emby, Jellyfin, and multiple cloud storage services (such as Alibaba Cloud, Baidu Cloud, and 115 Cloud), but also enables live TV streaming via WebDAV, SMB, FTP, and IPTV. Users can enjoy the convenience of iCloud syncing their viewing history, enabling a seamless playback experience across multiple devices. In addition, SenPlayer offers full support for HDR10 and HLG, ensuring outstanding HDR performance on Apple devices. It is compatible with a wide range of devices, including iPhones, iPads, Apple TVs, and Macs. The app also offers a range of practical features, including file management, video recording, a private space, and security lock, ensuring a convenient and secure viewing experience for users.

item.title: PasteNow 2.40
item.description:
Lightweight clipboard management tool for macOS

PasteNow is a Mac clipboard management tool that supports data synchronization across multiple devices and the reuse of historical data. It can intelligently categorize clipboard content based on rules and offers various list styles, such as grid views and simple lists, to display the content. Users can preview text, links, and images, and can also add sensitive apps to the exclusion list to protect their privacy. PasteNow relies on iCloud to achieve cloud-based data synchronization, ensuring that clipboard history can be shared across different devices. It also supports full keyboard operation and custom hotkeys to improve operational efficiency. Users can also collect and organize clipboard content using the drag-and-drop feature and selectively save data by setting exclusion rules, providing convenient preview and editing functions. PasteNow is a brand-new clipboard management tool that supports data synchronization across multiple devices, allowing users to easily reuse clipboard history data and categorize history content using rules. Content Preview: Preview clipboard text, links, and image content, with support for HEX color display. Rich views: Clipboard content can be displayed in a variety of styles, including grid view, simple list, and rich list.

item.title: Splice 1.5.0
item.description:
Quick input of animated emojis on Mac

Splice is a quick emoji and GIF input tool for macOS. It brings Slack-like colon-triggered input and animated GIF search to any input scenario in the system, allowing users to find the right reaction in chats, emails, documents, or collaboration tools with just a few keystrokes. It supports the input of trigger words such as :sparkles, which then displays matching emojis as inline candidates. Combined with fuzzy search, usage frequency sorting, and number key shortcuts for selection, it reduces the time spent manually browsing. The software also provides a full Emoji Board and GIF Board, making it easy to browse, search, and insert emojis or animated GIFs. GIFs can be sent as links or files, and frequently used GIFs can be saved and assigned custom keywords. Both keyboard shortcuts and triggers can be customized, making the overall experience more suitable for Mac users who engage in extensive chatting, community management, remote collaboration, and who like to use emojis to convey tone.

item.title: Peekaboo 0.1.22
item.description:
Mac Natural Language File Search

Peekaboo is a file management and disk space organization tool for macOS. It works with Finder, retaining common features such as tabs, column views, path bars, and file tags, and groups files by type, including images, videos, documents, and applications. The software supports natural language search and can convert file type, date, size, source, and folder criteria into editable filter options. It can also recognize text in screenshots, photos, and PDFs and categorize files by download source. Space Map presents disk usage in an interactive space map, combining the detection of duplicate files, similar photos, old downloads, and unused apps to help identify space that can be freed up. Regular cleanup moves items to the Trash and allows undoing actions one by one through the activity log. Built-in batch renaming, automatic folder organization, cloud storage directory integration, and 105 file and system tools, covering tasks such as PDF processing, audio and video conversion, transcription, and translation. Mac Health provides the status of the processor, memory, disk, network, and battery, along with a week's history.

item.title: Notchy 2.0.12
item.description:
macOS bangs augmentation tool

Notchy is a native macOS agile island and efficiency tool that turns the bangs area of the screen into an interactive control center that can run as a suspended capsule on Macs and external monitors without bangs. The software integrates music playback, synchronized lyrics, clipboard history, file staging, pomodoro timing, window snapping, and system status prompts to focus common actions at the top of the screen, reducing the number of switching windows and lookup menus. For development scenarios, it can track the usage, quota window and expenses of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other tools, and display the execution status of agent activities, permission requests and long-time commands. Face unlocking is achieved through camera, Apple Vision local recognition and live detection. Facial features and passwords are saved in the macOS keychain, which is a convenient unlocking function, not equivalent to the infrared depth recognition of Apple Face ID. Notchy also provides app-independent volume, AirPods battery, OCR image text search, meeting suggestions, calendar reminders, and shortcut entries to support custom panels, gestures, and multiple real-time events displayed side-by-side.

item.title: Chronoid 1.0.108
item.description:
AI Time Tracking Tool

Chronoid is a time tracking software designed to increase user productivity, featuring AI-driven automatic classification that seamlessly tracks the user's work activities without having to manually turn on or off the timer, thus avoiding distractions. The software tracks user activity on apps, websites, and documents and automatically detects when users leave or are idle. Chronoid also provides visual analytics that give users a clear view of their time allocation, work patterns, and most productive time periods through interactive charts. Built-in focus tools, such as website blocking and pomodoro, help users focus and reduce distractions. Users can discover patterns of time consumption and personalized productivity insights by talking directly to their activity data. Chronoid has no subscription fees and protects users' private data, making it suitable for a wide range of users, especially freelancers and students who need to manage their time effectively. Chronoid is an efficient time tracking tool designed to help users be more productive.

item.title: Awesome Copy 8.1b4
item.description:
macOS Clipboard Manager

Awesome Copy is a powerful clipboard history manager designed for Apple users to improve speed, design, and privacy. It tracks everything a user copies, including text, images, links, files, and music, allowing users to quickly access, reuse, and organize clipboard content at any time. The app brings together useful features like dynamic island-inspired file previews, the iOS companion app, and comprehensive two-way sync to ensure a secure and seamless docking of clipboard history between Mac, iPhone, and iPad. In terms of privacy, AwesomeCopy uses local storage and iCloud encryption, never tracking the use of data or sharing clipboard content to ensure that users' privacy is protected. Customize your workspace with 16 beautiful themes and enjoy Siri shortcut integration, rich text support, and advanced features like text-to-speech, auto-paste, and customizable global hotkeys. AwesomeCopy is a full-featured clipboard history manager built for Apple users who value speed, design, and privacy.

item.title: Solace 1.0.61

item.title: Almighty 2.13.9
item.description:
Quick-action enhancement tool for macOS

Almighty is an app with more than 50 Mac tweaks to improve your experience. It lets you easily customize settings such as hiding desktop icons, masking keyboard input, and showing the cursor and keystroke visualization. It manages system settings like clearing the clipboard, converting text to plain text, scheduled shutdown and dark mode, offers deep Dock and Xcode customization (Dock appearance, build times, disabling auto-restore), and tunes Finder settings such as showing or hiding files and adding a Quit option. Everything is reachable from the menu bar. It is written entirely in Swift, is native to the Mac and collects no data.

item.title: CrewTower 1.0.44
item.description:
Lingdong Island AI Agent Request Approval

CrewTower is a native AI agent session management tool for macOS users that centralizes tasks from desktop applications, editors, and terminals such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, and opencode into a floating capsule at the top of the Mac or on other displays. Users can view task progress, context usage, running status, completion reminders, and requests that need to be processed without frequently switching windows. They can also directly approve or reject supported commands, answer questions, select solutions, review plans, and submit feedback. For dangerous operations, CrewTower displays clear warnings and provides options such as one-time, current session, or always allow. Jump takes the user back to an accurate app window, tab, terminal window, panel, or tmux pane.
